identity.name: Nautilus
identity.one_liner: The 5711's successor: same design language at 41mm, moved from steel to white gold.

narrative.story: Announced in October 2022, the 5811/1G answered the question everyone asked after the 5711 died: what replaces it? Patek's answer was the same time-and-date Nautilus, one millimeter larger at 41mm, in white gold only. Thierry Stern's point was deliberate — the entry Nautilus would no longer be a steel watch. It keeps the 26-330 S C and adds a micro-adjustment fold-over clasp.
narrative.collector_notes: At a glance it reads as steel, which is part of the appeal and part of the resale discount versus the 5711's mania. Blue-black gradient dial only so far; allocation still runs through relationship-based boutique lists.
